It Started with One Printing Line

DecoSupplier started with one printing line and a small team of workers who had spent over a decade in the PVC film industry. We saw too many good products lose their price edge through layers of middlemen. We saw too many overseas buyers struggle to find a reliable, direct source. So we built our own.
We don't trade. We don't represent brands. We manufacture — from substrate preparation and pattern printing to finished slitting — all under one roof. No markups. No opaque pricing.

From that first printing line to today's multi-hectare manufacturing base, from single-category PVC film to seven product lines covering flooring, wall panels, and refinishing films — we stay committed to one thing: helping global buyers get quality materials at a fair price, directly from the source.
From raw material processing to finished goods — every facility is equipped to deliver consistent quality and reliable supply.
Our manufacturing base spans tens of thousands of square meters. Core equipment includes:
High-speed gravure printing lines — multi-color registration capability, high precision, minimal color deviation.
Embossing and lamination lines — precise grain alignment with printed patterns.
Adhesive coating equipment — scaled production of self-adhesive products.
Automated slitting and packaging lines — efficient delivery and product protection.
We don't do piecemeal production. We deliver stable, high-volume capacity — built for bulk procurement from global partners.
Quality is Not a Process — It's a Habit
At DecoSupplier, quality control doesn't just happen on the testing bench. It's embedded in every step:
Incoming material inspection — every batch of base film ink and adhesive is verified.
In-line monitoring — real-time checks along the production line.
Finished product testing — scheduled physical tests for wear resistance waterproofing and colorfastness.
Pre-shipment verification — the final checkpoint before every roll leaves our warehouse.
One quality failure can undo ten trust-building efforts. We'd rather slow down than let a defect pass.

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for PVC decorative film?
Our standard MOQ is 500 square meters per pattern and color. For first-time cooperation we support small-batch trial orders to help you evaluate our quality.
Can I get free samples before placing a bulk order?
Yes we provide free samples for quality evaluation. You only need to cover the shipping cost. Sample delivery typically takes 3-7 days via international express.
What are the available thickness options for PVC decorative film?
Our PVC decorative film thickness ranges from 0.12mm to 0.45mm with customized tolerances ≤ 0.01mm. Specific thickness can be tailored to your application requirements.
How long is the typical production lead time?
Standard production lead time is 15-20 days after cylinder proofing and sample sign-off. For urgent orders we can accommodate expedited schedules upon request.
Can you customize patterns and colors for my brand?
Absolutely. We support custom pattern development, color matching, and private labeling (OEM/ODM). Our team works closely with you to bring your design vision to life.
What surface finishes are available for your products?
We offer a variety of surface finishes including matte, gloss, textured wood-grain, high-gloss UV coated, and embossed finishes to meet different aesthetic and functional requirements.
What certifications do your products hold?
Our products are RoHS compliant, formaldehyde-free, and low VOC. We also hold ISO 9001 quality management certification, ensuring consistent product quality across all batches.
What are your shipping and trade terms?
We operate on FOB China Port terms (Yiwu, Shanghai, Ningbo). We can also accommodate CIF and EXW upon request. We handle all shipping arrangements and customs documentation.
What is the expected lifespan of LVT flooring?
Our LVT flooring typically lasts 10-15 years under normal use conditions. The wear layer thickness and maintenance practices are key factors influencing longevity.
Are SPC wall panels suitable for bathrooms and kitchens?
Yes, SPC wall panels are 100% waterproof and moisture-proof, making them ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and other high-humidity areas where traditional wall materials may fail.
